audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields told the player to 'use W to block his Q' and to use 'E to interrupt his all-in dash'. Ring of Frost is a 450-range root that freezes enemies — it blocks nothing, and Glacial Path is a claw Lissandra can travel to, not an interrupt.
audit.why: A player told W blocks Razor Shuriken will stand still and press it into a 900-range projectile, which is a free trade for Zed every time. The real interaction is that W's 450 radius covers the spot Death Mark drops him — 625 range, and he is targetable again the moment the dash ends.
audit.corrected: W described as a 450 root held for the shadow swap and the R arrival; E kept as the follow-up, not an interrupt.
sources: enemyKit R range and untargetable flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side gave Lissandra all seven rows; content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra.
audit.why: Pre-6 Zed genuinely sets the terms — Razor Shuriken is 900 to Ice Shard's 725, Shadow Slash falls to a 3s cooldown, and his costs are energy rather than a mana bar that runs out. The lane only becomes a counter-pick at 6, when the tomb exists.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 moved to Skill with rewritten whys; rows 4-6 already agreed and stayed Lissandra, with phases[4].why regrounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 phase said only that Lissandra becomes 'the best anti-dive mid in the game' — no mechanism.
audit.why: Death Mark stores a portion of the damage Zed deals over 3 seconds and then repeats it. Self-cast Frozen Tomb makes Lissandra untargetable and invulnerable, so the repeat lands on nothing, and it costs him a 120/110/100s ultimate against her 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, dosFull[0] and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the 3-second window and both ultimate cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT — breakdown.cooldowns had no number.
audit.why: The 3-second mark timer and Living Shadow's 20s are the two clocks this lane is played on.
audit.corrected: Death Mark 120s/100s and its 3-second delay, Living Shadow 20s, Frozen Tomb 120s written in.

edits.before: The early game is a skill check: Zed shoves with W-Q-E and looks to land his poke, while you use W to block a Q and E to interrupt his all-in. Respect his level-3 all-in window when he has energy, but every time he commits without ult you can W his damage and E-Q him back.
edits.after: The early game is a skill check: Zed shoves with W-Q-E and looks to land his poke, while you hold W to root anything that closes to 450. Respect his level-3 all-in when his energy is full, but every time he commits without ult you root him and E-Q him back.

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are a genuine skill matchup. Zed wants to poke with Q and shove you in with W to set up roams, so track his energy and use W to block the key Q while keeping E up to punish any dash-in; if you play the wave even and dodge his poke, neither of you gets ahead.
edits.after: Levels 1-5 are a genuine skill matchup. Zed wants to poke with Q and shove you in with W to set up roams, so track his energy and hold W to root him the moment he closes to 450, keeping E for the punish after; if you play the wave even and dodge his poke, neither of you gets ahead.

notes: Main fix: four fields claimed Ring of Frost 'blocks' Razor Shuriken and that Glacial Path 'interrupts' his dash. W is a 450 root, E is a claw she can travel to; neither blocks or interrupts anything in Riot's text. Rewritten around the real geometry — Death Mark lands him at 625, W covers 450 around her, and self-cast Frozen Tomb's untargetable/invulnerable window covers the mark's 3-second repeat. Chart: full layer gave Lissandra all seven rows while content matched the packet; rows 0-3 moved to Skill with paired why rewrites, rows 4-6 already agreed. No win[N] edits were possible — content already holds the correct values. Not asserted (kit silent): whether the Death Mark repeat is prevented outright or merely mistimed by the tomb, whether Zed can Living Shadow out of Ring of Frost's root, and whether Zhonya's stasis and Frozen Tomb behave identically against the mark — the existing Zhonya's text was left as written. Zed is male; pronouns unchanged.
